test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of :: ?

#: ACG:: CEI: %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

Given:

# : ACG :: CEI : %

Analysis of Options:

**Option 1) # = WYC , % = KIM**

**For # (WYC) to ACG**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3efb89b14b486fa8d147718194d14592928974afae65fd20e7cbf7bbf628664e.png] 

**For CEI to % (KIM)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/34b8c9a309857dcb5ff2b6c7c3b0a14bc5e8a44a902fac721400fc8620b84930.png] 

**Option 2) # = WYC , % = GIM**

**For # (WYC) to ACG**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8a22d85fdfd75dedc8910c3596b85e96f4f22168cd076a165d2cebe074c26bf7.png] 

**For CEI to % (GIM)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/56ffe0a0c63a605608953f2d56cc1a6bc4534601a1507795896d272dcde9dfb6.png] 

Since the pattern for WYC to ACG (+4, +4, +4) is the same as the pattern for CEI to GIM (+4, +4, +4),

**Option 2 is correct.**

**Option 3) # = WYC , % = GIK**

**For # (WYC) to ACG**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d814c80d88550bb4e6b36215e5c44a410d82d9cba3d7ff47d0b9bf93a6957c9e.png] 

**For CEI to % (GIK)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/facd08f215c7464ab2b4994a50590bf33742b618b37e7824faad29f4520f6406.png] 

**Option 4) # = XYC , % = GIM**

**For # (XYC) to ACG**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6787987c501f2722e473127b5077d5876f0a16f1b6f2b57ac25bf202292e4cd6.png] 

**For CEI to % (GIM)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/65fb89e429b2f3e90993b3debb5fe2635c527230f37835ca4653d01ccdddcf35.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
